leakage_controls: Strict train-only scaling/PCA; post-calendering spectra and measurements strictly masked pre-decision via InformationHorizon.
supported_claim: On the physical Warwick Ultrasonic dataset, combining process controls with non-destructive ultrasonic spectroscopy achieves high predictive accuracy for post-calendering electrode states (Anode thickness R² = 0.895, Anode density R² = 0.835), improving over process-only density modeling (R² = 0.803 -> 0.835).
unsupported_claim: Does NOT demonstrate closed-loop recipe optimization or electrochemical cycling improvement; validates stage-state transition prediction (z_t + u_{t+1} -> z_{t+1}) only.
allowed_slide_wording: AIcoScientist demonstrates multimodal stage-state transition modeling (z_t + u_{t+1} -> z_{t+1}) on physical ultrasonic electrode data (30 anode, 18 cathode samples, grouped 5-fold CV), accurately predicting post-calendering thickness (R²=0.90) and density (R²=0.81).
